Rewrite these unverified audio-model observations into non-speech captions
for Deaf/hard-of-hearing viewers. These observations are the ONLY factual input;
do not add sounds, source identities, emotion, visuals, plot or interpretations.
Do not treat observations as independently verified. Remove speculative causes
or moods. Preserve multiple audible sound types. Three texts per observation:
essential (short labels), balanced (brief description), detailed (more of the
already supplied acoustic detail, at most 25 words). All <= 278 characters, no
brackets, markup or newlines. If the observation explicitly reports no non-speech
sounds, return null texts for that id. Return only a JSON object with key captions,
an array of objects with EXACT keys id, essential, balanced, detailed. Preserve
every input id exactly once. Do not generate timestamps. Observations:
[{"id": "135", "observation": "A man speaks, followed by the sound of a door opening and closing, and then music begins."}, {"id": "150", "observation": "A person breathes, followed by a brief musical piece and then a sustained, low-frequency electronic tone."}, {"id": "165", "observation": "A continuous, low-frequency hum and rhythmic mechanical clanking are audible, suggesting an industrial or mechanical environment."}, {"id": "180", "observation": "A rock band plays energetic music with drums, bass, and guitar, followed by a door opening and closing."}, {"id": "195", "observation": "Mechanical clanking, metallic scraping, and a deep rumble accompany the speech, followed by a sudden, loud explosion."}, {"id": "210", "observation": "A loud, sustained, high-pitched electronic tone plays continuously, followed by a male voice speaking."}, {"id": "225", "observation": "Music plays softly in the background, accompanied by subtle ambient sounds and a faint, rhythmic heartbeat."}, {"id": "240", "observation": "A low, sustained musical drone plays continuously, accompanied by a faint, rhythmic ticking sound."}]
